newsitem.title: BELGIUM: RESEARCH ALERT - SOLVAY CUT TO 'REDUCE'.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SOLVAY CUT TO 'REDUCE'.

text.p: Brokerage KB Securities analyst
Jurgen Fryges (+32 2 546 51 74) said in a report dated July 1 he
downgraded his recommendation for Solvay shares from
'accumulate' to 'reduce' at current prices.
Investment conclusions:
A dramatic drop in caustic soda and peroxygen prices will
lead to a lower than forecast 1997 current result. Since Solvay
is the leading peroxygen producer and third caustic soda
producer worldwide, we expect the negative impact on current
earnings to be more outspoken than for other chemical companies.
Hence we expect Solvay's share price to underperform
vis-a-vis the Bel-20 share index.
A possible blockbuster drug to be launched in four to five
years: Solvay currently develops a new class of antidepressants
and anxiety drugs. The product is Solvay's most important drug
development of the lqst years.
Solvay will split its shares by 10 to increase the
attraction for small investors. Moreover 18 million Belgian
francs of existing reserves will be incorporated in the issued
capital, increasing it from 32 francs to 50 francs.
Highlights 1996:
- current earnings decreased by eight percent due to
depressed plastic and caustic soda prices.
Outlook:
- peroxygens: price erosion in 1997;
- caustic Soda prices remain under pressure;
- plastic margins, and especially in polyethylene (HDPE),
are improving;
- health sector: promising market entrance in Japan expected
for 1998, promising new class of anti-depressant in full
development.
